name: Beck's Greenhouse & Vegetable
tagline: Beck's Greenhouse & Vegetable — Apples in Elk River, MN
description: Beck's Greenhouse & Vegetable is an on-farm market in 15362 190th Ave, MN, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
